sugestoes.texto: WHAT: Single static header comparison gates overwrite of any userId/appSlug credential keys with decrypted attacker-influenced JSON. WHY: Anyone holding the shared secret can overwrite any user's third-party OAuth keys, hijacking calendar/video access with no per-user auth, HMAC, replay protection, or rate limit. HOW: See improvedCode; at minimum require HMAC-signed body with timestamp.

The comment requires 32 bytes for AES256 but the generation command `openssl rand -base64 24` produces only 24 bytes, so a user following the docs creates a key that disagrees with the documented requirement and will fail/shorten encryption. Change the command to `openssl rand -base64 32`.

issues.descricao: A loggable, prefetchable, CSRF-able `GET` carrying the shared secret can overwrite any user's stored OAuth keys. Reject non-`POST` requests with a 405 before any secret, user, or app lookup.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: record_for_host returns false on failure but callers use eh.try(:category_id), and try only guards nil so false.try(:category_id) dispatches to FalseClass and raises. WHY: TopicEmbed.import (app/models/topic_embed.rb:36-43) crashes on malformed/unknown embed URLs instead of handling nil category. HOW: return nil instead of false consistently.

WHAT: every embed comment/retriever check now does a SELECT via record_for_host instead of the previous in-memory SiteSetting string check. WHY: adds a DB round-trip to the hot unauthenticated embed path on every request, increasing latency and DB load. HOW: cache the host list with expiry and invalidate on EmbeddableHost save/destroy.

issues.descricao: Model types with multiple underscores never match `ADMIN_MODELS` and get the wrong base path. Change `type.replace('_', '-')` to use `/_/g` so all underscores are replaced.

sugestoes.texto: Next clamps to user_count, which is past the last page when count is a multiple of limit (e.g. count 100, limit 50, offset 50 -> 100 empty). Clamp to (totalPages-1)*limit instead.

issues.descricao: The cached `groups.user_count` stays inflated, so admin pagination and counts disagree with actual membership. In `remove_member`, destroy the `GroupUser` records instead of calling `users.delete` so `counter_cache` decrements.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: canMapRoles/canMapCompositeRoles/canMapClientScopeRoles only check fine-grained permission and never check MANAGE_CLIENTS role, unlike canManage/canManageClientScopes siblings. WHY: A realm admin with manage-clients (or existing V1 behavior) is incorrectly denied role-mapping on clients, breaking the implied-admin contract.

issues.descricao: A global grant is silently ignored once any per-client resource exists, denying legitimate admins in `hasPermission(ClientModel, String)`. Check the per-client resource from `findByName` and then the all-clients type resource from `getResourceTypeResource` so either grant succeeds.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: MaxCount cleanup fetches victim IDs with LIMIT/OFFSET then deletes them in a separate statement with no transaction. WHY: Concurrent deletion of newer rows between fetch and delete shifts the OFFSET window, so a fetched ID can slide back into the top-MaxCount set that must be kept yet still gets deleted. HOW: Re-check membership or perform the delete atomically if exact MaxCount retention is required.

untilDoneOrCancelled stops when batchWork returns affected==0, but batchWork now returns RowsAffected from deleteByIDs after a separate fetchIDs with LIMIT. Under concurrent deletes the fetched IDs can already be gone so delete affects 0 even though unfetched matching rows remain beyond the LIMIT window, causing early exit with MaxAge/MaxCount/orphan invariant still violated. Terminate on fetched count == 0 instead of deleted count == 0.

issues.descricao: A concurrent deleter racing between `SELECT` and `DELETE` leaves work remaining until the next cycle. Check `fetched` from `batchWork` instead of `affected` to decide when `untilDoneOrCancelled` is done.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: AuthzClient.create calls global CryptoIntegration.init which initializes a static singleton only once with the authz classloader view. WHY: If called before server init with a classloader seeing only the order-100 Authz provider, the server is permanently pinned to the weak provider whose methods throw UnsupportedOperationException.

issues.descricao: Because `CryptoIntegration.init` is one-shot, calling `AuthzClient.create` first cements the global singleton with its own classloader and the minimal `AuthzClientCryptoProvider`, so later server init is ignored and unsupported operations break. Guard the init in `AuthzClient.create` or avoid global init from the lightweight client.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: canView(user)/canManage(user) dropped ADMIN role from hasOneAdminRole check. WHY: Admins relying on ADMIN role lose view/manage access (denial) diverging from prior contract and V1 behavior. HOW: Restore AdminRoles.ADMIN in the role checks or prove ADMIN is handled elsewhere.

issues.descricao: With V2 all-groups `VIEW`/`MANAGE` granted, every listing costs O(N) authz evaluations instead of one. Restore the cached `canViewGlobal` check from `auth.groups().canView()` and short-circuit the per-subgroup `canView(g)` filter when it passes.

sugestoes.texto: WHAT: _get_partition_lock reads/writes partition_locks dict without any global lock, so two threads adding a new partition can create two different Lock objects. WHY: Threads then guard add_offset/complete_offset/get_committable with different locks, breaking mutual exclusion and corrupting all_offsets/outstanding commit decisions. HOW: Guard lock creation with a global lock for partition_locks.

SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.submit passes FilteredPayload to decoder and expects None to skip+commit. The wired decoder partial(self.decode_payload,...) asserts not isinstance(payload, FilteredPayload), so filtered messages raise AssertionError into the generic except instead of the intended None fast-path (error log + reliance on exception fallback). Guard FilteredPayload before delegating to decode_payload.

issues.descricao: The background thread keeps calling `get_committable_offsets` and `commit_function` after rebalance/terminate with revoked partitions. After signaling `shutdown_event`, join `commit_thread` in `terminate` as `close` does.
